title: DependencyRationales
description: Flat overlay: per external workspace dependency, the rationale + owner + layer seam + replacement strategy. Joined with `cargo metadata --no-deps` output at lane time. Replaces the over-engineered tech-debt-ledger.json planned in original IP-002 (state machine + trigger DSL + monotonic graph DROPPED per multispectrum F1 + F2 + F6 critique).

_meta.purpose: Documents each external workspace dependency rationale, owner, layer seam, and replacement strategy for policy gates.

hyper.rationale: HTTP I/O protocol — h1/h2 framing. Selected over axum/actix/poem per ADR-0090: bare protocol surface, smallest transitive cost. Workspace-wide directive 2026-05-14: hyper for framework; we build router/middleware/SSE ourselves above this layer.

hyper-util.rationale: Tokio + auto-builder helpers for hyper. Adapter-local; no kernel exposure. Provides ConnBuilder used for slowloris-defense timeouts (ADR-0092 Phase 8 S4).

http-body-util.rationale: Full<Bytes> body collector + Limited<B> bounded-collector. Limited is the load-bearing primitive for S3 unbounded-body DoS defense (ADR-0092 Phase 8).

bytes.rationale: Byte buffer type for hyper bodies. After ADR-0092 Phase 2, only the adapter declares this dep; kernel uses Vec<u8> and the adapter converts at the boundary. Was previously leaked into oya-http-middleware-kernel + 3 middleware crates + ops-runtime — those leaks are CLOSED.

tokio.layer_seam: adapter-only (current) + future async chain when ADR-0094 cancellation lands
tokio.rationale: Async runtime (rt-multi-thread + net). No realistic alternative for async HTTP server in Rust today. Adapter declares; ops-runtime indirectly via the adapter and #[tokio::main].

tracing.rationale: Span/event API. Used by observability adapter at infrastructure layer. Kernels and domains must NOT depend on tracing — pure types don't emit spans. Current usage is bounded.

tracing-subscriber.rationale: Subscriber registration. Should ONLY appear in composition-root (app) binaries — never in libraries — so binaries decide their own log routing.

serde.rationale: Serialization framework. Used by adapters (DTOs) and application orchestrators (event emission). Kernels SHOULD NOT depend on serde — pure domain types don't carry serialization. (Some kernels currently do via convenience; the lane will report-only flag these as candidates for adapter-side DTO mapping per ADR-0092.)
serde.isolated_in_crate: adapter and application layer crates; kernel violations report-only

serde_json.rationale: JSON ser/de. Strictly adapter-layer; kernel responses use hand-rolled formatting per 0-to-minimal-deps directive (see oya-ops-workspace-shell-runtime).

toml.rationale: TOML reader (Cargo manifest parsing in lane crates). Tooling/lane only. Domain code must not consume TOML directly.

toml_edit.rationale: Format-preserving TOML editor (workspace mutation tools). NOT used by production code paths. Tooling-only.

lane_contract.registry-coverage: Every name in [workspace.dependencies] (from cargo metadata) MUST appear in entries. Orphan rows in entries (deps removed from workspace) trigger warning.
lane_contract.layer-seam-check: For each entry, verify NO crate outside `isolated_in_crate` (or its compatible layer scope) declares or imports the dep.
lane_contract.cargo-audit-shell: Run `cargo audit`; pass if exit 0; flag CVE findings against entries for owner attention.

evolution_policy.add_dep: 0-ADR action: add an entry row alongside the [workspace.dependencies] line. Lane fails until row exists.
evolution_policy.remove_dep: 0-ADR action: remove the entry row alongside removing the workspace dep.
evolution_policy.change_layer_seam: 1-ADR action: tightening or loosening which layer may consume a dep requires an ADR. Loosening MUST cite a concrete need.
evolution_policy.cve_response: Owner team has 7 calendar days from CVE publication to either patch-bump the version_pin OR file an ADR exception with mitigation. CI tracks via cargo-audit-shell sub-check.

decision_log.what_changed: registry created with 11 seed entries; replaces over-engineered tech-debt-ledger from original IP-002
decision_log.why: Multispectrum F1 + F2 + F6: state machine + trigger DSL + monotonic transition graph are control plane for problems that don't exist at 11-dep scale. Flat 5-field-per-row overlay solves the actual problem (track + own + decide-removal-path per dep) in 50 lines instead of 500.
